Senior Citizen Pension & Healthcare Enrollment

Citizens aged 60 and older can apply for monthly social security support and healthcare benefits using the accessible application form below.

Enter your 12-digit number without dashes or spaces (e.g. 123456789012).
Table of Monthly Pension Entitlements by Age Bracket
Age Bracket Monthly Support (INR) Healthcare Coverage Tier
60 to 69 Years ₹2,500 / month Primary Care + Essential Medicines
70 to 79 Years ₹3,500 / month Comprehensive Inpatient + Outpatient
80 Years & Above ₹5,000 / month Comprehensive Care + In-Home Nursing

Please review the full terms: Download 2026 Citizen Pension and Healthcare Guidelines (PDF, 240 KB).
